areas.t: Current Conditions (Friday afternoon, 11/6/2026): A reinforcing cold front is crossing through western Pennsylvania this afternoon, bringing a shifting wind direction out of the northwest and isolated showers. The change in wind is creating good air quality for fine particulate matter (PM2.5) today.
